json.note: Answered by the server without running the script: how to call bridge.openOverlay, bridge.closeOverlay, bridge.setReaction, bridge.componentize, bridge.setProps, bridge.setText, bridge.replaceWithInstance, bridge.shift, bridge.moveInto, bridge.fitSection, bridge.setPosition. Call it directly in the write; don't read its source. `return bridge.info()` lists every helper.

signatures.openOverlay: await bridge.openOverlay(triggerId, overlayFrameId, { position: 'BOTTOM_CENTER', dim: 0.4, closeOnOutside: true }) - prototype link that opens the overlay frame (transition slides in from the edge). position: CENTER | TOP_LEFT | TOP_CENTER | TOP_RIGHT | BOTTOM_LEFT | BOTTOM_CENTER | BOTTOM_RIGHT; dim: alpha 0..1 or '#000000@0.4'. The overlay look is read-only in the Plugin API: the reply says which part is a MANUAL STEP for the user - report it, don't look for a setter.
signatures.closeOverlay: await bridge.closeOverlay(nodeId) - CLOSE action on a node inside an overlay.
signatures.setReaction: await bridge.setReaction(nodeId, { trigger: 'ON_CLICK', to: frameId, nav: 'NAVIGATE', transition: 'MOVE_IN/LEFT' }) - one prototype link (replaces the one with the same trigger); action: 'BACK' | 'CLOSE' | { type: 'URL', url } instead of to/nav.
signatures.componentize: bridge.componentize(node) -> the new COMPONENT (sync; pass the node object, e.g. await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id)). Same name, size, position, look and AutoLayout sizing; the id CHANGES. Many at once: const out = []; for (const id of ids) out.push(bridge.componentize(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id)).id); return out;
signatures.setProps: bridge.setProps(instance, { Name: value }) - component properties by readable name ('Label' matches 'Label#12:3'); INSTANCE_SWAP takes a component node or id; returns the instance.
signatures.setText: await bridge.setText(root, { layerNameOrId: 'text' }) or bridge.setText(textNodeOrId, 'text') - loads all fonts and sets TEXT layers found by id or exact name under root, KEEPING font styles by words - font, size, colour, decoration, letter spacing (first word keeps its style, the tail from the first space keeps its own; more styles: word by word, extra words take the last). Replace text with it, never with `characters =` (that flattens mixed fonts) or a per-character getRangeFontName loop. Returns { set: [ids] }.
signatures.replaceWithInstance: await bridge.replaceWithInstance(target, component, { props, text, keepSize: false, remove: true }) - instance of a COMPONENT / COMPONENT_SET / id in target's slot; returns the instance.
signatures.shift: bridge.shift(nodesOrIds, { dx: 0, dy: 0 }) - moves nodes by an offset; returns the count.
signatures.moveInto: bridge.moveInto(nodesOrIds, container, { layout: 'none' | 'row' | 'column', gap: 100, padding: 0 }) - reparents nodes; returns ids.
signatures.fitSection: bridge.fitSection(section, { padding: 100 }) - resizes a SECTION/FRAME to its children + padding; returns the section.
signatures.setPosition: bridge.setPosition(node, x, y) - sets x/y, or explains why not (inside an INSTANCE: use AutoLayout).
